ops.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS N FROM t_object WHERE Object_Type = 'Interface' AND Package_ID = 1127 AND ParentID = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) AS N FROM t_object WHERE Object_Type IN ('Object','Component','Actor','InteractionOccurrence','MessageEndpoint') AND Classifier > 0 AND ParentID = 0 AND (Package_ID BETWEEN 1132 AND 1135 OR Package_ID BETWEEN 1144 AND 1152)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS N FROM t_object WHERE Object_Type = 'MessageEndpoint' AND ParentID = 0 AND (Package_ID BETWEEN 1132 AND 1135 OR Package_ID BETWEEN 1144 AND 1152)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS N FROM t_object WHERE Name = 'Object' AND Package_ID BETWEEN 1124 AND 1152

SELECT COUNT(*) AS N FROM t_object c INNER JOIN t_object p ON c.ParentID = p.Object_ID WHERE p.Stereotype = 'Data Transfer Object' AND p.Package_ID BETWEEN 1132 AND 1135 AND (c.Name LIKE '% Request' OR c.Name LIKE '% Response')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.Object_ID) AS N FROM t_object o INNER JOIN t_objectproperties t ON t.Object_ID = o.Object_ID WHERE o.Stereotype = 'Service Realization' AND o.Package_ID BETWEEN 1132 AND 1135 AND t.Property = '505-1 Operation Link' AND t.Value LIKE '{%'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.Object_ID) AS N FROM t_object o INNER JOIN t_diagram d ON d.ParentID = o.Object_ID WHERE o.Stereotype = 'Service Realization' AND o.Package_ID BETWEEN 1132 AND 1135

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.Object_ID) AS N FROM t_object o INNER JOIN t_objectscenarios s ON s.Object_ID = o.Object_ID WHERE o.Object_Type = 'UseCase' AND o.Package_ID BETWEEN 1144 AND 1152 AND s.ScenarioType = 'Basic Path'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.Object_ID) AS N FROM t_object o INNER JOIN t_objectconstraint c ON c.Object_ID = o.Object_ID WHERE o.Object_Type = 'UseCase' AND o.Package_ID BETWEEN 1144 AND 1152
SELECT COUNT(*) AS N FROM t_connector WHERE Connector_Type = 'Usage' AND End_Object_ID IN (12051,12207,12208)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS N FROM t_diagramobjects WHERE Object_ID IN (12207,12208) AND Diagram_ID BETWEEN 1218 AND 1226

SELECT COUNT(*) AS N FROM t_connector c INNER JOIN t_object e ON c.End_Object_ID = e.Object_ID WHERE c.Connector_Type = 'Usage' AND e.Stereotype = 'Service Realization' AND c.Start_Object_ID IN (12060,12061,12062,12063,12065,11961)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS N FROM t_objectproperties t INNER JOIN t_object o ON t.Object_ID = o.Object_ID WHERE o.Package_ID BETWEEN 1124 AND 1152 AND t.Property = 'code-ref' AND t.Value LIKE 'v0.21%'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS N FROM t_objectproperties t INNER JOIN t_object o ON t.Object_ID = o.Object_ID WHERE o.Package_ID BETWEEN 1124 AND 1152 AND t.Property = 'code-ref' AND t.Value = 'v0.22 (0c3e207)'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS N FROM t_operationtag x INNER JOIN t_operation p ON x.ElementID = p.OperationID WHERE p.Object_ID BETWEEN 11937 AND 11950 AND x.Property = 'code-ref' AND x.VALUE LIKE 'v0.21%'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS N FROM t_operationtag x INNER JOIN t_operation p ON x.ElementID = p.OperationID WHERE p.Object_ID BETWEEN 11937 AND 11950 AND x.Property = 'code-ref' AND x.VALUE = 'v0.22 (0c3e207)'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS N FROM t_attribute WHERE Object_ID BETWEEN 11977 AND 11984
SELECT d.Diagram_ID, d.Name FROM t_diagram d WHERE d.Package_ID = 1127 AND d.Diagram_ID NOT IN (SELECT Diagram_ID FROM t_diagramobjects WHERE Diagram_ID BETWEEN 1170 AND 1250)
